Struct BarChart

Namespace
Tuinet.Widgets
Assembly
Tuinet.dll

Bars that compare values, with eighth-block ends. Tuinet.Direction.Vertical bars grow up from the bottom, Tuinet.Widgets.BarChart.BarWidth wide, with the label under each bar and the value above it (inside its top when the bar is full height). Tuinet.Direction.Horizontal bars grow right, one row each, after a label column as wide as the widest label (at most a third of the width), with the value after the bar. Bars that don't fit are dropped from the end. Zero, negative and NaN values draw no bar; values over Tuinet.Widgets.BarChart.Max are clamped.
